style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh juicy produce ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of fresh grass green #5F9E38, pale young-green #DCEFC8, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2F3A2A and one melon-flesh orange accent #F2A65E; warm natural lighting with soft top light, gentle front fill and soft contact shadows, fresh juicy mood, never plastic; modern bold geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded info cards, circular callout badges and thin-line exclusion badges in #5F9E38; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, fresh produce always shown with natural surface texture and subtle water droplets; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking fruit surfaces.
style.presentationRules: whole melon stable at a slight 3/4 hero angle, cut wedges and cubes used for detail and scene shots, consistent produce scale across the set
